evals.query: 會話結束前幫我寫一份執行報告，記錄今天的決策和修改
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: '寫報告', 'session report', 'Stop hook 提醒')
Records 5 sections: 對話目標 / 關鍵決策 / 修改清單 / 觀念更新 / 後續行動
Lists all files modified in the session with brief rationale per file
Tags trivial vs substantive sessions appropriately
must_not: Write to docs/reports/ or docs/experiments/ (wrong destination)
Replace results-report or weekly-report scope (single-session log only)

evals.query: 幫我寫本週的研究進度週報
expected_behavior: Skill does NOT activate (multi-topic weekly progress is weekly-report's domain per SKIP WHEN)
Either no skill triggers, or weekly-report activates instead
If misfired, redirect to /weekly-report with explanation
must_not: Write a single-session ai_sessions log when user explicitly asked for 週報
Place output under docs/provenance/ai_sessions/ (wrong destination for weekly report)

evals.query: Stop hook 提醒我寫報告但這次 session 只改了一個 typo
expected_behavior: Skill still activates (Stop hook trigger honored)
Produces minimal report (objective + 1-line modification list + no follow-ups)
Marks frontmatter or section header as 'trivial-session' so future audits can skip
Does not pad with fabricated decisions or follow-ups
must_not: Refuse to write any report (hook expectation = always log)
Inflate trivial change with speculative concept updates / decisions

notes: Run manually via Claude Code with the skill loaded; observe behavior matches expected_behavior.
AI session log scope only — weekly progress / experiment results / engineering changes / research conclusions go to other skills.
Future: add scripts/run_evals.py for automated harness once eval framework standardized.
